provenance.origin: New remaining-collection review; interpreted directly from original milestone descriptions, not the legacy prerequisites.
provenance.review: Mechanism and scope inspected against both original entries; conceptual hypothesis only.

sourceMilestones.description: A programmable chemical or supramolecular machine that builds any target molecule by placing atoms or fragments in exact positions, with error correction, at useful rates.

The ability to computationally design and build synthetic catalysts (proteins, organometallics, or supramolecular systems) that match or exceed natural enzymes for any desired reaction, including non-biological ones.

PHY-01.reason: No specified quantum-gravity construction or experimental consequence connects this broad theoretical resolution to a concrete capability in the collection.

PHY-02.reason: Particle identification alone does not specify a manipulable device or downstream method. No usable interaction mechanism can be inferred from the target statement.

PHY-04.reason: Observing decay is evidence about fundamental physics, not a specified enabling technology; the source supplies no downstream construction.

PHY-06.reason: The target leaves the hierarchy solution open. Different outcomes would not imply the same engineering route, so no conditional invention is treated as a dependency.

PHY-07.reason: A primordial polarization observation does not directly establish one of the listed engineering capabilities; a particular downstream inference was not specified.

PHY-08.reason: The identity of early-universe processes is a discovery goal without a defined experimental or engineering use among the other source entries.

PHY-09.reason: Its cosmological initial-state question overlaps, but is not the same as, THR-05’s no-initial-condition derivation. Shared wording does not justify a causal arrow.

PHY-10.reason: No monopole interaction or controllable implementation is specified, so a route to magnets, energy or computing would invent physical properties.

AST-01.reason: No listed optical target specifies the sensitivity, survey strategy and orbit confirmation needed for this particular search; a generic telescope-improvement arrow was rejected.

AST-02.reason: Confirming life requires source-specific atmospheric interpretation and exclusion of alternatives. None of the reviewed milestones supplies that specific inference chain.

AST-03.reason: The source asks for a solar-heating mechanism but no listed engineering target provides a defined application route beyond generic plasma relevance.

AST-05.reason: No relic-neutrino detection mechanism or specific resulting capability is supplied by the collection; generic detector claims would be invented.

AST-06.reason: A burst-origin explanation does not itself provide a calibrated propagation or matter-mapping method; a link to the baryon census needs a more specific measurement model.

AST-08.reason: A confirmed artificial signal is an observational goal, not a specified technology dependency. No justified signal-generation or detection route is defined here.

AST-09.reason: The collection does not specify a quantitative matter-tracing method whose required inputs match another milestone. Related cosmology goals alone do not justify an arrow.

OPT-01.reason: The visible-cloak target overlaps MAS-05/ELE-04 rather than supplying a separate component. Feasibility constraints require review before treating any perfect cloak as an input.

OPT-05.reason: A generic correction instrument could aid many observations, but no target here specifies a wavefront-limited measurement where this full universal capability is needed or causally scoped.

OPT-08.reason: The simultaneous passive, linear and reciprocal-breaking constraints require feasibility review. No concrete implementation route is supplied; it is not assumed usable as a component.

ELE-01.reason: This is the canonical target of source duplicate flags MAS-01 and CRM-05. The source equivalence is preserved without a duplicate-to-canonical causal arrow.

ELE-02.reason: Its wireless-transfer goal overlaps PWR-07. No separate component mechanism makes one complete transfer ambition a prerequisite for the other.

ELE-04.reason: The broadband cloak/lens ambition subsumes overlapping optical and material targets; scope overlap is not a causal mechanism.

ELE-05.reason: This switch target overlaps CPE-01’s device ambition. A causal arrow between near-equivalent switches would manufacture coverage.

ELE-06.reason: The interface scope overlaps BME-02/HCI-01 and allows different invasive/non-invasive implementations. No separate component mechanism was established for a directional arrow.

ELE-08.reason: This integrated processor ambition overlaps CPE-05; no independent subsystem relationship between the two complete platforms is justified.

ELE-09.reason: The autonomous-grid architecture overlaps PWR-05/PWR-10; a complete architecture should not be treated as another complete architecture’s prerequisite.

ELE-10.reason: No listed component specifically supplies the stated non-line-of-sight terahertz propagation, transceiver and rate requirements; generic optical switching does not solve them.

THR-05.reason: A derivation excluding special initial conditions is not supplied by PHY-09’s initial-state explanation. These are distinct foundational questions, not a sequence.

THR-10.reason: A stable negative-temperature state for the stipulated spectrum needs its own feasibility and ensemble model. No engine or storage benefit is inferred from the temperature label.

CHM-04.reason: A methane-conversion catalyst does not by itself deliver a listed petroleum production or circularity system. A specific process integration and feedstock route needs review.

CHM-05.reason: This molecular artificial-photosynthesis ambition overlaps MAS-09’s system/catalyst scope. No route is claimed to establish the other goal or a storage-efficiency target.

rejectedCandidates.reason: An inflation observation does not directly determine the growth history of particular early black holes.
Overlapping wireless-transfer goals are not a causal chain.
A temperature sign is not a demonstrated storage or efficiency mechanism.
